query: Wan2.2 I2V A14B workflow with two-pass HIGH/LOW samplers crashes in WanVideoImageToVideoEncode: VAE expects 36 channels but input has 68 — classic wrong-VAE symptom (68 = 36+32 extra latents from end_image/extra channels path).

desired.outcome: Commenter chenxluo gives the definitive cause: use the Wan2.1 VAE, not the Wan2.2 VAE from the ComfyUI repo, citing the identical issue #1281. Not OP-confirmed in thread.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; proposed fix is actionable and directionally correct.
